RUSTENBURG LOCAL MUNICIPALITY (North West) - acct [number removed],
Telkom site 12P CHURCH STREET / OU DORP, ERF 2413.  9 PDFs: Jul, Aug,
Sep, Nov, Dec 2025 and Jan, Mar, Jun, Jul 2026 (Oct 2025, Feb, Apr and
May 2026 are not in the pack).  2-3 pages each, the whole masthead +
meta block repeated on every page.

SAME BILLING ENGINE AS DITSOBOTLA SHAPE B - tri-lingual
'TAX INVOICE / BELASTINGFAKTUUR', 'VAT Reg No./ BTW Nr./ No. Ya
Lekgetho', 'Invoice No:INV [number removed] 202607', 'Month/Maand/Kgwedi:',
'Statement Date/Staat Datum/Letlha la Mokwalo' (value on the NEXT line),
'Due Date/Betaaldatum/Tuelo go Fitlha', 'Account  [number removed]',
'ERF No/No Ya Tulo', 'Surburb/ Voorstad/ Tulo', 'Extent/ Grootte/
Botona', 'Mkt Value/ Markwaarde/', 'Category/ Kategorie/ Karolo',
'Street No/ Straat Nr/ Leina', ledger columns Date / Description / VAT /
Debit / Credit / Balance, the 'Meter Number  Factor  Date From  Date To
Band From  Band End  Rate  Units  Description  Reading Type  Exclusive'
sub-table under each charge row, the 180/150/120/90/60/30/Current/Amount
Due ageing strip, 'VAT Total', 'Amount Due/Verskuldig/ Sekoloto',
'Deposit/ Deposito/ Peeletso', 'Guarantee/ Waarborg/ Netefaletso:',
'Payments up to/ Betalings tot / Tuelo go Fitlha:'.

NUMBER FORMAT - NO COMMA-DECIMAL TRAP HERE.  This is the important
difference from Ditsobotla shape B.  Ditsobotla prints SPACE thousands +
COMMA decimal ('55 473,14'), which _to_decimal() turns into [number removed] -
100x too big - forcing the rand-part-only workaround.  Rustenburg prints
COMMA thousands + PERIOD decimal ('116,348.45', 'R45,646.03',
'258,239.85').  _to_decimal() deletes the commas and the value parses
EXACTLY.  Every Rand figure in this profile is CENT-EXACT; there is no
rand-part workaround, no '*_txt' twin field and no cent-exact variant is
needed.  A zero VAT still prints with no leading digit ('.00'), so the
money token used throughout allows an empty integer part:
  (?<![\d.])(-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[ ,]?\d{3})*)?\.\d{2})(?![\d])
'.00' therefore reads 0.00 rather than being dropped.

THE DEBIT COLUMN IS VAT-INCLUSIVE and the VAT is printed separately, so
ex-VAT figures ARE derived with 'sub' computes per register family -
exactly as for Ditsobotla.  BUT the bill ALSO prints its own ex-VAT
figure in the meter sub-table's 'Exclusive' column, so each canonical
Rand column is a 'prefer' over (printed Exclusive, Debit - VAT); the
delta between the two is carried as rus_*_excl_delta.

THREE ELECTRICITY CHARGE FAMILIES, and they must not be confused:
  'Elec Cons (KWH) 71677KW - [[number removed] to [number removed]]'   -> energy   (kWh)
  'Elec Demand (KVA) 116.98KVA - [0 to 116.98]'        -> demand   (kVA)
  'Network Access - All Season 234KVA - [0 to 234]'    -> network access
Energy -> standard_kwh / standard_r (single-band convention: one kWh
register, no time-of-use).  Demand -> demand_kva / demand_r.  Network
Access is the notified-capacity charge -> nmd_kva / nmd_r.  There is NO
basic/fixed charge line at all, so other_r is '_none'.  Rustenburg bills
no rates, refuse or sewerage on this account - only electricity, water
and payments.

MID-MONTH TARIFF CHANGES SPLIT EVERY ROW IN TWO.  On 4 of the 9 bills
(Jul 2025, Sep 2025, Jun 2026, Jul 2026) each charge is printed TWICE
with two different rates and the consumption split between them, e.g.
Jul 2025 '20710.76KW ... @3.10' + '42802.24KW ... @3.49' = 63 513 kWh =
the [[number removed] to [number removed]] register difference.  BOTH rows are real
debits (the Balance column applies both).  So every quantity and every
money rule on this profile is collect:"sum".  Jul 2026 additionally
prints two all-zero registers ('0KW - [0 to 0]' legacy, '0KVA - [0 to
0]' generation) which sum in harmlessly as 0.00.  The register bracket
on the ledger line is the WHOLE period ([[number removed] to [number removed]]); the one
inside the meter sub-table is the per-band midpoint ([number removed].5) and
must NOT be used - the reading rules therefore anchor on
'Elec Cons (KWH)', which only ever appears on the ledger line.  On the
split bills the ledger description WRAPS, so the closing reading sits on
the next line; end_reading_kwh crosses the newline with [\s\S]{0,80}?.

TELLING KVA DEMAND FROM NETWORK ACCESS in the meter sub-table: both
print 'nnnKVA - [...]', so the Exclusive column cannot be attributed by
the description.  They are separated by the meter number, which the
engine prints on the WRAP LINE BELOW the data row: 'KVA83' for demand,
'NETWORK ACCESS' (continuation of '[number removed]-') for network access.  The
two Exclusive rules therefore end with '\n[ \t]*KVA\d+' and
'\n[ \t]*NETWORK ACCESS' respectively.  The unambiguous ledger-derived
Debit - VAT is the fallback for both.

SECTIONS.  The masthead and the whole meta block repeat on every page,
and the literal heading 'Electricity' appears 3x per bill (once per
charge family) with the ledger interleaved across page breaks.  As for
Ditsobotla, electricity is the ONLY boundary-forming section - it starts
at the first 'Electricity' heading and therefore runs to the end of the
document - and water and sundry are "overlay": true with "end": "\\Z" so
they span to the end and cut nothing.  'header' is the text above the
first 'Electricity' heading, i.e. exactly the page-1 meta block, which
is why the account/site/date rules never pick up the blank repeats on
pages 2-3.  The sundry section starts on the 'PAYMENT THANK YOU' row
itself (present on 9/9 bills) rather than the 'Payments' heading (only
3/9).  Every rule anchors on its own description text, so nothing leaks
across services.

RULE ZERO.  The bill prints no ex-VAT ELECTRICITY subtotal, so
total_ex_vat_r (rus_elec_total_ex_r) is the SUM OF ITS OWN PARTS and the
engine's reconcile is CIRCULAR here - it cannot fail.  Four genuinely
independent identities are checked instead, and all four are carried in
the data:
 (1) printed 'Exclusive' == ledger Debit - VAT, per register family
     -> rus_kwh_excl_delta / rus_kva_excl_delta / rus_nac_excl_delta.
 (2) end_reading - start_reading == sum of the printed KW quantities
     -> rus_kwh_qty_delta.
 (3) Sum(VAT column, every charge row incl. water) == printed 'VAT Total'
     -> rus_vat_delta_r.
 (4) Balance Brought Forward + Sum(Debit) - Sum(Credit) == printed
     'Amount Due' -> rus_due_delta_r.

RECON BLOCK - ONE KNOWN LIMIT.  The bill prints its payments in an
unsigned CREDIT column ('PAYMENT THANK YOU  .00  337,564.70  269,429.95'),
so recon's incoming_payment comes out POSITIVE - there is no leading
minus, no trailing minus and no 'Cr' for _recon_money() to read, and a
regex-only profile cannot invent a sign.  extract_recon() then derives
subtotal = prev_balance + incoming_payment, which for this profile must
be read as prev_balance MINUS incoming_payment.  Only that one derived
cell is affected: prev_balance, current_ex (from the ageing Current
column minus VAT), vat, total_due and due_date are all taken straight
from printed figures and are correct, and the payment itself is carried
correctly as rus_payment_r / rus_payment_col_sum_r on the sundry row.

FINGERPRINT.  Anchored on the municipality's own VAT registration
4840112868 (9/487 files in the pack, all Rustenburg), the masthead
'Rustenburg Local Municipality', the statement mailbox and the portal.
NOT on 'TAX INVOICE / BELASTINGFAKTUUR' (41 files - shared with
Ditsobotla, Matlosana and Sol Plaatjie), NOT on 'VAT Reg No./ BTW Nr./
No. Ya Lekgetho' (18 files - shared with Ditsobotla), and NOT on the
Setswana line 'O tshwanetse go duela' (20 files - shared with
Matlosana), which is the sentence whose 'tshwaneTSE' substring satisfies
the 'cot' profile's all-gate.

fields.label: Municipality VAT registration
fields.pattern: VAT Reg No\./ BTW Nr\./ No\. Ya Lekgetho[ \t]*:[ \t]*(\d{10})(?![\d])

fields.label: Payments up to / Betalings tot
fields.pattern: Payments up to/ Betalings tot / Tuelo go Fitlha:[ \t]{2,}(\d{1,2}[ \t]+[A-Za-z]+[ \t]+\d{4})

fields.label: Sum of the VAT + Debit columns over every charge row (all services)
Sum of the Credit column over every PAYMENT row
Elec Cons (KWH): VAT + Debit incl VAT
Elec Demand (KVA): VAT + Debit incl VAT
Network Access: VAT + Debit incl VAT
Total kWh (sum of the Elec Cons rows)
Demand kVA (sum of the Elec Demand rows)
Network Access kVA (sum of the NAC rows)
Water Cons: VAT + Debit incl VAT
